---
date: 2022-01-01
title: What we built together
---
We wrote this piece together, and the first-person plural is deliberate
throughout. We argue that the method only works when two people hold it.

We tested that claim across four projects, and we kept notes on each one.

We are the ones who would have to defend the evidence in a cite, and that
is exactly why Q-51 says a co-authored item is excluded whole, with a reason.
